name: npm test | tail && git commit
command: npm test 2>&1 | tail -5 && git commit -m fix

name: go test | head && git push
command: go test ./... | head -50 && git push origin main

name: 管道 | tee 再 deploy
command: npm run build | tee build.log && vercel deploy --prod

name: 已开 pipefail
command: set -o pipefail; npm test | tail -5 && git commit -m x

name: 末段是 grep -q（退出码有意义）
command: npm test | grep -q PASS && git push

name: 引号里的字面文字
command: git commit -m "npm test | tail -4 && git push"

name: 默认模式只看输出不拦
PIPESTATUS 显式取码
command: npm test 2>&1 | tail -5; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ] && git commit -m x

name: 注释里的管道
command: npm test && git commit -m x  # not: npm test | tail && git commit
